title: automation: a dispatch on a connection already marked reconnect required, and the onGrantRefused log, still say the authorization server refused the grant whatever the stored cause
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① two out-of-scope findings of the #28863 dev (PR #28955, os-dev-report on #28863), same class as that card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): admin-facing text that names the wrong cause; no write or status is wrong.

Reach: an admin reading a dispatch refusal or the server log for a connection marked `reconnect_required` because no refresh token was issued or no client is kept.

## What happens (read at PR #28955's head `7cf0294a`)

PR #28955 makes the stored `status_reason` name the cause on each refresh path. Two places still say the authorization server refused the grant whatever happened:

1. **The dispatch refusal of a row already marked.** `grant-handle.ts` (`select` ≈L238, and `refreshOnce`'s first check) and the plugin's hold-reason fallback (`plugin.ts` ≈L3189) answer with `reconnectRequiredReason`'s default `'refused'` sentence, not the row's stored `statusReason`. So the first dispatch says "no refresh token was issued" and every later one says "refused".
2. **The `onGrantRefused` warn line** (`plugin.ts` ≈L3697) logs "the authorization server refused the grant" on all three refresh paths.

## Wanted

The refusal of an already-marked row answers with the cause the row stores (its `statusReason`, or the cause it was marked with), and the log line names the cause. Same wording as PR #28955. ⛔ No new status value or error code.

Dedupe: searched `reconnect required dispatch refusal stored statusReason`, `onGrantRefused log refused the grant`. Related: #28863 / PR #28955. **New.**
